purpose: Close or rule out newly discoverable independent public raw data for the remaining IJHE validation gates without reusing an already opened holdout.

sources.title: JRC Reference Data from Experiments on Onboard Hydrogen Tanks Fast Filling
sources.data_type: full-scale hydrogen tank filling and emptying experiments
sources.access_observation: The JRC publication record describes a reference database, but its Datasets and Dataset collections fields contain no public machine-readable URL. The linked public material is a publication/figure record.
sources.blocking_reason: No rights-cleared pressure-temperature time-series export was available from the public record.

sources.title: JRC GasTeF experimental papers and facility records
sources.access_observation: The records document Type III/IV filling conditions and instrumentation, but do not expose a downloadable raw logger archive for a new frozen score.
sources.blocking_reason: A plotted range or paper figure cannot close the Type-III prospective temperature gate.

sources.title: H2-Stations European hydrogen refuelling station export API
sources.data_type: station metadata, availability, events and aggregate operational signals
sources.access_observation: The public API provides station and availability information; it does not provide synchronized pressure, temperature and mass-flow logger traces for a component holdout.
sources.blocking_reason: No raw process trace or apparatus boundary is available.

sources.title: DTU-TES Hydrogen-Fuelling-Station Modelica library
sources.access_observation: The repository contains Modelica components and property files, not independent measured pressure, temperature or release traces.
sources.blocking_reason: Simulation code cannot be counted as an external experimental validation dataset.

sources.title: Existing Light-Duty Hydrogen Refueling Stations In-Use Study Report
sources.data_type: operational study report and plotted station examples
sources.access_observation: The report contains station-use and fueling figures, but no rights-cleared common-clock station/controller/vehicle raw bundle was exposed in the public report.
sources.blocking_reason: It cannot close the station-side component holdout or the excluded station-to-vehicle full-loop gate.

sources.title: H2SAFE, ELVHYS, USN open-channel and other current repository sources
sources.access_observation: These sources are already represented by frozen protocols and retained outcomes in the repository. Recounting them as new holdouts would violate the access-order rule.
sources.blocking_reason: Outcome access and prior diagnostics are already recorded.

conclusion.next_action: Obtain a rights-cleared, previously uninspected Type-III temperature-pressure trace or a new independent pressure-decay/release campaign, then freeze the scoring protocol before opening outcomes.
conclusion.claim_boundary: The current study may report the existing bounded component results and retained negative findings, but may not claim full independent Type-III thermal, outdoor consequence-distance, spatial detector-transfer or station-to-vehicle validation.
